title: CLI pins (tools.json)
description: Each CLI a skill shells out to, the lowest version the skills need, and the version they were last checked against. Any installed skill may ship a tools.json beside its SKILL.md; check-tools.mjs merges them. It validates these rules itself (it has no JSON Schema library); this file is for editors.

snapshotMaxAgeDays.description: How old a release snapshot may be before it is ignored. Default 14; the smallest value across files wins.

version.description: Command that prints the installed version; pattern group 1 is the version.

env.description: Extra environment for the probe, e.g. to switch off a CLI's self-update check.

usage.description: Regex that finds a skill invoking the tool. Dependents are derived from it, not listed.

min.description: Lowest version any skill relies on. Below it, a skill breaks.

verified.description: Version the skills were last checked against. Moved by --bump.

notes.description: Version-specific behaviour a skill relies on or works around.
